E4Plus1.uk.description: Desperately Seeking Lisa: Lisa visits Capital City with Patty and Selma, where she's swept up in the city's art scene. But the big city's got an underbelly. (S36 Ep3/18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Tableau Vivant: Jay and Gloria get on each other's nerves while trying to order lunch, and Cam and Claire can't agree on how to discipline children. (S3 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Baby on Board: Trying to adopt another child has been an emotional roller coaster for Mitch and Cam. They bring Gloria in as translator, leaving Jay and Manny to look after Lily. (S3 Ep24)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Harsh truths are laid bare as homestays begin, with family and friends rather unhelpfully wading in to one couple's relationship. (S13 Ep30)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Aaron, who won The Traitors' first season, is out on a date with a straight-A student Laura. Plus: a date on roller skates and a Mr Bean impression. (S21 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Last Man Expanding: Springfield's hooked on a weight loss drug. Homer's not sold on it, until Marge begs him to take it. But there's a side effect... (S36 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: P.S. I Hate You: Marge's reputation as Springfield's nicest resident is jeopardised when her secret stash of vitriolic letters is stolen during a house party. (S36 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Hollyoaks
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pearl tries to build bridges between torn families, while Jack's caught in the middle of Beth and Nancy. Diane confides in Tony and Leela about her fears. And a resident wants the truth...

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Australia - Brand new series: The homestays continue, but real-world problems are putting all of the couples under strain. And there's a devastating confession. (S13 Ep31)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Made in Chelsea: Sam...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Vanderpump's Story - Brand new series: Sam and Alice navigate joy and hardship as they prepare for parenthood while Sam grapples with the idea of a living donor liver transplant. (Ep2/2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's sharpest armchair critics have been watching: Sitting on a Fortune, Close to Me, You, Nadiya's Fast Flavours, Animal, UFO Witness and This Morning. (S18 Ep9)

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Trawlermen
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Coming Home: Fearless fishing! Amity is 100 miles offshore in the infamous Devil's Hole - things look bleak for skipper Jimmy as the engines which haul in his nets are near to failure. S1 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Trawlermen
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: More high drama on the high seas as we follow trawler fishermen in Peterhead in Scotland. Trawler Ocean Venture is caught in a force nine gale that endangers the lives of her crew. S2 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Teleshopping
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Shopping from Home.

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Warsaw to Krakow: Michael Portillo uses his 1913 copy of Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide to explore Poland, visiting Warsaw, Lodz, Poznan, Wroclaw and Krakow along the way. S3 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Lucy Worsley Investigates
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Witch Hunts: Lucy Worsley examines four dramatic chapters in British history, beginning with the 16th-century witch hunts, when thousands of people were tortured and killed. S1 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Bugatti / Pedal Plane: The team are on the hunt to restore one of the greatest names in motoring history - the Bugatti. But with a strict budget they settle for a replica. S3 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Mondeo / MZ 250: The team take on a modern day fast Ford to see if a 'quick flip' could make a few quid and revisit a 3 year MG restoration project that's still not finished. S3 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: The World at War
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Genocide: How did Heinrich Himmler plan to realise Hitler's vision of a pure Aryan Germany? Actor Laurence Olivier explains as he narrates the acclaimed documentary series about WWII. S1 Ep20

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Nazi Hunters
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Jewish Avengers: After World War II, a Jewish group called the Avengers decided to hunt down known Nazis. Hear how they tracked their targets, including lawyer Wilhelm Stuckart. S1 Ep8

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: New. Roundhay Park, Leeds 3: The team are in Roundhay Park, Leeds, where they see treasures including family photos of Arnold Schwarzenegger, and an original script for Dad's Army. S46 Ep16

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: New. Pollok Park, Glasgow 3: Fiona Bruce presents from Pollok Park in Glasgow, where treasures include an early painting by Jack Vettriano, and pages from the first printing presses. S46 Ep17

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: E Type S2/Escort RS Turbo: A classic car fan with a love of the Jaguar E-Type reluctantly sends his dream car to auction, hoping to buy a motorhome. Two Ford Escorts get Dave's pulse racing. S1 Ep9

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Rolls Silver Shadow/Austin 7: A widow reluctantly parts with her husband's treasured collection of Rolls Royces and Bentleys, and an impulse buyer finds one of the cars a new home. S1 Ep10

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Frozen Planet
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Autumn: Witness how solar landscapes change as the big freeze returns. Most animals leave on epic journeys, some battle to breed and for a few it is a time of opportunity. S1 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Frozen Planet
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Winter: During winter most animals abandon the polar regions, but a few extreme survivors remain. This is the story of their battles to endure the planet's harshest winters. S1 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Capri/Alpine/Lancia Fulvia Zagato: Derek heads to Sunderland to pick up a real Italian beauty - a 1972 Lancia Fulvia Zagato. Red and racy, the car has seen better days but Derek's still impressed. S9

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Alvis/Vauxhall Cavalier/BMW CS Coupe: Derek acquires a collection of pre and post war classics, including a Vincent Rapide, a 1928 Alvis, a Ford Pilot and an Indian Scout with sidecar. S13 Ep12

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Planet Earth
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: New. Ocean: The wildlife inhabiting the world's oceans, from the shallow seas of the tropics where predators become the prey, to the greatest depths, captured on film. S3 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: The Green Planet
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: New. Water Worlds: David Attenborough presents a guide to the world of plants that grow in water, including a river in Brazil, where the plants have created their own atmosphere. S1 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Flipping Bangers
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Volvo: Will and Gus lay their hands on a potentially very valuable Volvo. It's great to look at, but doesn't start easily and cannot stop. S1 Ep7

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Henry Cole tries to restore a monkey bike, and Simon O'Brien makes use of all his skills as he tries to give new life to an old racing bicycle. S1 Ep17

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Trawlermen
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Gripping reality series about trawler fishermen in Peterhead in Scotland. Ocean Venture is in the grip of a storm with her nets caught on the seabed - can first mate Barry free them? S2 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Trawlermen
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Braving the elements with those hardy trawler fishermen in Scotland. Ominous weather warnings mean that Sandy Watt must decide whether to brave violent storms or head for safety. S2 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Shopping from Home.

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Haifa to the Negev: Michael Portillo travels through Israel and Palestine, visiting Jerusalem's Christian, Jewish and Muslim quarters and Bethlehem in the West Bank. S3 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Lucy Worsley Investigates
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Black Death: Lucy Worsley examines Britain's deadliest pandemic and explores how its monumental death toll changed the face of the country for ever. S1 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Alfa / 2CV: A 90s Alfa with electrical issues lives up to its stereotype and the team revisit a road roller, four years on. They also tackle a French motoring icon, the Citroen 2CV6 Dolly. S3 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Volvo / Audi / Hillman: The Restoring Classics team take Derek's advice when he sniffs out the rarest car they've ever taken on - the last remaining Hillman GT. S3 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: The World at War
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Nemesis: The final death throes of the Third Reich described by Laurence Olivier. Hitler retreats to his bunker as Germany crumbles around him and Allied troops arrive in Berlin. S1 Ep21

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Nazi Hunters
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Killing of Reinhard Heydrich: One of the main architects of the Holocaust, Reinhard Heydrich was assassinated by British-trained Czechs in 1942. This is the story of his downfall. S1 Ep9

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: New. Ebrington Square, Derry/Londonderry 3: Fiona Bruce pays a final visit to Ebrington Square in Londonderry, where treasures include a statue from Java, and dazzling 1960s jewellery. S46 Ep18

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: New. Swanage Pier and Seafront, Dorset 3: Fiona Bruce pays a final visit to Swanage Pier in Dorset, where treasures include shipwreck finds, and a jewel encrusted bird. S46 Ep19

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Capri 208/Chevrolet Panel Van: A near-perfect 50s Chevy panel van and a very desirable low-mileage 80s Brooklands Capri tempt auctioneer Derek out of Yorkshire. S2 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: TR6/Lotus Cortina/Daff Saloon: The team struggles to explain how a DAF 33 gearbox works, and office manager Sarah attempts to bring order to the auto memorabilia sale. S2 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Last Frontier: The penultimate part of David Attenborough's acclaimed nature series. This episode looks at us humans, one of the polar regions' most ingenious inhabitants. S1 Ep6

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: David Attenborough journeys to the poles to investigate what rising temperatures will mean for the people and wildlife that live there, and for the rest of the planet.

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Train Truckers
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: High-Speed Super Train: Kevin and Kieran move three state-of-the-art trains, fresh in from Japan. They need to transport them from the North East port of Redcar to a factory in Doncaster. S1 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The Price Crash: Siwrengale skipper Darren Warters and his sons are out in the North Sea for the whelk season, and the Endeavour 5 is in the North Atlantic in search of squid. S1 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Planet Earth
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: New. Deserts and Grasslands: Life in some of the many deserts and grasslands around the world, including in the Namib desert, where ostriches raise their family in the searing heat. S3 Ep3
